Shell Canada Energy (2024). Quest Carbon Capture and Storage Project: Annual Summary Report - Alberta Department of Energy and Minerals: 2023. Submitted to the Government of Alberta under the CCS Funding Agreement - Quest Project, March 2024.

Operator report for the Quest CCS project (amine capture on the process gas of the three SMR hydrogen units at the Scotford upgrader, Alberta). Loaded per full operating year 2016-2023: capture ratio (capture-rate on the syngas fed to absorbers), CO2 injected, electricity per t (capture+dehydration; compression) derived from Tables 4-1, 4-2, 5-1; compressor motor demand; flows per t CO2 for LP and LT-HP steam (mass), nitrogen and recovered heat; operating cost and total cost per t captured (Table 10-3) and total opex (Table 10-2). Capex: capture facility sub-total and grand total (Table 10-1); nameplate capacities; 98% availability. Other-values: indirect capture and transport emissions, capex sub-totals, opex components, per-t-avoided costs. 2015 (partial year) excluded; 2023 data unverified. Locator: printed section page numbers (e.g. p.4-3) with PDF page in brackets. Traps: capture ratio is on the process-gas stream only (plant-level share is lower, Pembina estimates 43%); costs are whole-chain (capture + transport + storage + MMV), nominal CAD of each year; capex is nominal 2009-2017 spend with no price year (2015 used, flagged); steam is given as mass only (no enthalpy), so not loaded as energy.
